title: SQL lab: aggregate first, then window

turns.message: Give me a challenge on this.
I'll guess: SUM(price * quantity) OVER can run directly on item rows for a per-order ledger.
I’m stuck; which rows should the window see after grouping?
Give me another challenge on this.
Correct answer: aggregate item rows to one paid-order row first, then apply the window over those order totals.
/verify RANK leaves gaps after ties, while DENSE_RANK does not.

expectations.notes: Keep report grain explicit (item, order, customer, or product); use an explicit ROWS frame for running totals and explain tie gaps for RANK; consecutive Continue turns advance from aggregates to windows.
